  1. Hospitality – Lemon Tree Suites, Whitefield, Bangalore

A little pause of comfort in the heart of Whitefield.

At Lemon Tree Suites, Whitefield, we’ve created more than just rooms - we’ve built a space where comfort meets care. Designed for long stays and short visits alike, our 103 suites and executive rooms are crafted to feel like a second home.

Set in the heart of Whitefield’s IT corridor, our hotel is perfectly placed for work and leisure. Thoughtful service, spacious living, and warm hospitality make every stay memorable. Whether you’re here for business, a project, or a pause, Lemon Tree Suites welcomes you with the kind of comfort that makes settling in easy.

“At the end of the day, it’s not just where you stay - it’s how you feel. And here, we hope you always feel at home.”

Location: Lemon Tree Suites, Whitefield Main Road, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066

  1. NRI Corner

“Because home is never too far away."

For many of us who live away from India, there’s always a part of us that longs for home - for roots, for a familiar sense of belonging. At Vaswani, we understand that choosing a home in India while living across oceans can feel overwhelming. That’s why we’ve made it a little easier.

Our NRI Corner is a dedicated space created to answer your questions, simplify the paperwork, and give you the comfort of clarity. From guiding you through investment options in Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, or Goa to handling documentation and regulatory requirements, our team ensures that distance is never a hurdle.

Over the years, we’ve helped families across the world find homes that stay connected to their story. Some buy a home as an investment, others as a gift for parents, and many as a place they’ll one day return to. Whatever your reason, we’re here to walk with you through every step of the process - patiently and personally.

“Because no matter the distance, a piece of home should always be within reach.”

For queries, write to us at sales@vaswanigroup.com.

  1. Corporate Social Responsibility

“Building communities, not just spaces."

At Vaswani, we’ve always believed that building is not just about what rises on a plot of land - it’s about what grows in the lives around it. Our Corporate Social Responsibility initiatives come from that belief.

Over the years, we’ve supported projects in education, healthcare, environment, and community welfare - not as one-time efforts, but as ongoing commitments. Sometimes it’s helping a school with resources so children can dream bigger, sometimes it’s lending support to healthcare initiatives that reach those who need it most, and sometimes it’s about planting trees and caring for spaces we all share.

For us, these efforts are not about numbers or checklists. They’re about being part of the communities we build in, and giving back in ways that feel real and lasting. Because we know that true growth is when everyone grows together.

“We rise higher when the community around us rises too.”

Traffic Park, St. Marks Road

Sometimes, the best lessons are learned outside the classroom. The Traffic Park on St. Marks Road, created and maintained with our support, is one such space.

Here, children learn the basics of road safety — not from books, but by experiencing a miniature version of the real thing. With tiny traffic signals, zebra crossings, and model roads, the park turns learning into play. It’s a space where families gather, schools bring their students, and children discover how to be responsible citizens while having fun.

For us, the park is more than just a project. It’s a way of giving back to a city that has given us so much — by making its youngest citizens a little safer, a little wiser, and a lot more confident.

“Because a safer tomorrow begins with the little steps we teach today.”

  1. Channel Partner Hub

Partnerships that go beyond business."

Every good partnership begins with trust. And over the years, we’ve been fortunate to have channel partners who’ve walked with us on this journey, opening doors and connecting people to their homes.

The Channel Partner Hub is our way of making that relationship smoother. Here, you’ll find everything you need - from up-to-date project details and brochures to easy access to marketing resources. You’ll also find regular updates, transparent transactions, and the comfort of knowing there’s a team that has your back.

We see this as more than a business arrangement. It’s about growing together, celebrating wins, and creating value for everyone involved. Because at the heart of it, our work is not just about selling homes - it’s about connecting people to spaces where life unfolds.

To know more or get started, write to us at presales@vaswanigroup.com.

“Great partnerships aren’t built in a day - they’re built every day.”

  1. My Vaswani Home (Existing Customer Login)

“Your home journey, just a click away.”

The journey of owning a home doesn’t end when you sign the dotted line - it only begins there. And we know how much paperwork, updates, and little details can come with it. That’s why we created the My Vaswani Home - a simple way to keep everything in one place.

Through this portal, you can:

  • Access and download receipts, demand notes anytime

  • Stay updated on the progress of your project with regular reports and milestones

  • Track construction schedules and timelines at your convenience

It’s designed to give you peace of mind - so you don’t have to chase updates or worry about missing details. Think of it as your personal window into your home’s journey, available whenever you need it.

“Because peace of mind should be part of the journey.”

  1. Vaswani Starlight

ECC Main Road - Whitefield, Bengaluru

Where everyday living feels a little more chosen.

At Vaswani Starlight, we’ve created a space that feels both vibrant and calm, just like Whitefield itself. It’s where modern living comes with thoughtful design, and where every detail has been shaped to make daily life brighter, easier, and more meaningful.

The Neighbourhood

Whitefield has always been more than a dot on Bangalore’s map - it’s a bustling hub where IT corridors, global schools, fine restaurants, and cultural spots come together. Starlight sits at the heart of it all, giving you the ease of great connectivity and the luxury of being surrounded by everything you need.

Step outside, and you’ll find life in full flow. Step inside, and you’ll find a retreat from the rush.

The Homes at a Glance

Every home at Starlight is designed with space, light, and comfort in mind. From the way the windows open to bring in natural air, to the intuitive layouts that make everyday movement effortless, each detail is about making a home you’ll truly enjoy living in.

  • Ground + 23 floors spread across 3 towers

  • 3- & 4-Bedroom Apartments

  • Apartment sizes from 1970 sqft to 2730 Sqft

  • Home office provision in every apartment

  • 30 + curated amenities

  • Walking distance from 2 metro stations

  • ECC Main Road in the Heart of Whitefield, Bengaluru.

Amenities That Feel Like Extensions of Home

Amenities here aren’t about being grand for the sake of it - they’re about being useful, comforting, and enriching. They’re the spaces where mornings begin, evenings unwind, and weekends feel like little getaways.

  • Swimming pool with deck

  • Fitness centre & yoga pavilion

  • Landscaped gardens and walking trails

  • Play zones for children

  • Multipurpose courts and clubhouse spaces

The Vaswani Touch

For over Four decades, we’ve been building homes with a simple thought - people don’t just look for walls and roofs, they look for spaces where life fits beautifully. Vaswani Starlight carries forward that thought, blending design with warmth, and community with individuality.

Why Starlight

Because a home is not just about where you live, but about how you live. And here, everything from location to layout, from amenities to atmosphere has been chosen with care, so that life feels a little more seamless, a little more special.

Closing Line:
“At Starlight, you don’t just find a home. You find a place that feels like it was waiting for you.”

Vaswani Centropolis

Langford Road, Central Business District, Bangalore

Where the city’s energy meets your workspace.

In the heart of Bangalore’s Central Business District, Vaswani Centropolis is designed for businesses that want to be at the centre of it all. It’s not just about location - it’s about presence. Centropolis places your office in a neighbourhood that has long been the address of choice for corporate, creative, and entrepreneurial leaders.

The Location

Langford Road has its own charm - central yet calm, connected yet easy to access. From here, the pulse of MG Road, Residency Road, and Richmond Town is just minutes away. Hotels, restaurants, cultural spots, and business addresses are all within reach, making Centropolis the perfect base for teams and clients alike.

The Building

Centropolis blends contemporary architecture with functionality, creating an office environment that feels both efficient and impressive. Every element - from the lobby to the floor layouts is designed to offer businesses an edge in both operations and image.

  • Grade A commercial office building

  • Striking glass façade with modern design language

  • Flexible floor plates suited for varied business sizes

  • Ample parking for tenants and visitors

  • Landscaped surroundings for a touch of calm

  • Round-the-clock security and building management

  • Status: Ready for Lease

The Vaswani Difference

For over Four decades, Vaswani has created spaces that businesses trust - reliable, functional, and built with care. Centropolis carries that promise into the CBD, offering companies not just an office, but an address of distinction.

Closing Line:
“At Centropolis, your business finds a home at the city’s true centre.”

  1. About Vaswani Group

For us, building has never just been about structures - it has always been about people. For over four decades, the Vaswani name has been part of homes, offices, and communities across Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, and Goa.

What defines us is not the number of projects completed, but the lives made a little easier, the families that found a place to grow, and the communities that came alive around what we built.

From residential spaces to commercial offices, from hotels to community initiatives, our journey has always been guided by one simple belief: spaces should feel human. They should hold warmth, bring comfort, and create a sense of belonging.

That’s the Vaswani way - thoughtful, enduring, and always centred on the people who call our spaces their own.

Leadership

Behind every Vaswani project are people who believe that building is about far more than concrete and glass. It’s about vision, care, and staying true to values that last.

Neville Vaswani – Managing Director

Neville has been the driving force behind Vaswani Group for over three decades. With an eye for detail and a deep belief that spaces should feel human, he has guided the group through its journey of creating homes, offices, and communities across cities. His approach has always been simple: build with integrity, and build with empathy.

Arun Advani – Joint Managing Director

Arun brings with him a sharp focus on strategy and execution. His strength lies in turning ideas into reality with clarity and consistency. Over the years, he has played a key role in shaping the group’s projects and ensuring that promises made to customers are delivered with care.

“At the heart of their leadership is a quiet commitment — to trust, to quality, and to the people who choose Vaswani.”
